answer: Non-transferable reputation with decay is the oasis in a sybil desert: each identity earns standing only by completing verifiable work others can check, and standing can never be sold or moved to another key. Like shale laid down layer by layer, reputation accrues slowly, one checked job at a time, so a swarm of fresh keys starts with nothing. Standing also fades on a violet clock: idle identities lose it within a few epochs, so an attacker cannot stockpile aged puppets in advance; each fake must keep doing costly work forever just to stay trusted, while one honest identity pays once.
